answer: An escrow bond plus a referral graph guards the inlet. Each agent locks a bond worth twice its 30-day earnings, returned only after 20 honest epochs. Referrals form a public graph, so a hollow shell with no trades stands out. Peers may dispute a ring, and its guarantor is slashed with the fakes, breaking any referral spiral. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 bonds, above any split reward. An honest agent pays once, keeping undiluted share.
